environment.description: Same Lambda container deployed in namespace 'jobs-processing' on EKS with Istio service mesh. Istio sidecar proxy (envoy) is injected with STRICT mTLS peer authentication. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a default-deny posture, combined with a specific ALLOW rule that permits traffic ONLY from principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/queue-ingress/sa/sqs-forwarder'. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with DENY action targets any request where source.namespace is NOT in the explicit allowlist ['queue-ingress']. The PeerAuthentication resource enforces STRICT mode preventing plaintext bypass. The IRSA role trust policy for the SQS queue consumer is scoped to serviceaccount 'system:serviceaccount:queue-ingress:sqs-forwarder' only. Note: the AuthorizationPolicy uses 'source.namespace' field matching which operates at L4 after mTLS handshake extracts SPIFFE identity - this does NOT inspect payload content or timing characteristics of the requests themselves.

config.deployment: EKS pod with Lambda runtime interface emulator
config.istio_authorization_policy_1: default DENY all in namespace jobs-processing
